decisions.reason: The fruit-puree yogurt sits squarely in the firm's core cultured-dairy know-how and its award gave a readable signal, though its absence from the website since 2020 suggests reduced prominence.
As a flagship flavoured cheese built on established cheese competence, it is a product the firm can interpret and refine, so keeping it is justified despite the recent lack of website visibility.
A semi-hard cheese wheel is a close extension of existing production knowledge and the affiliated organic milk supply, so it carries little risk.
The spicy cheese line draws on existing know-how, and individual variants are more likely to be trimmed than the whole line dropped.
Washed-rind soft cheese is technically furthest from the firm's core, its results are hard to read, and with no visible presence since 2020 its resources are better redirected to core lines.
